subject: EU in-region inference: evidence checklist and SCCs questions
messages:
From: Marco Giordano <marco@privamed.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ana Ribeiro <ana.r@privamed.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: EU-only processing + SCCs — in-region inference, backups and deletion evidence

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking a look. We're evaluating vendors for in-region inference and need clear answers tied to Schrems II / SCCs. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm that inference requests, model execution, and any persistent caches/backups stay in an EU-only footprint?
- What evidence does Redwood provide for proof-of-deletion (service-level erasure versus operator/backup traces)?
- Are sub-processors (e.g., monitoring, logging, backups) restricted to EU data centers and covered by SCCs?
- What cryptographic custody / KMS options do you offer for EU keys?

I've attached our question set (Privamed-sccs-questions.docx) — can you either answer in a short checklist or set a 30-min call this week?

Best,
Marco
Marco Giordano
Head of IT Security, Privamed Health
marco@privamed.com

I attached a short advisory (SCCs_advice_v1.pdf) and a one-page architecture snapshot (redwood-eu-arch.png) that show our in-region runtime + control plane isolation options. Quick clarifications so our internal team can prepare the checklist:

- When you say "backups" do you mean automated snapshots of model cache/KV stores, long-term backups of logs, or both?
- Do you require separate KMS per-tenant (customer-managed) or is BYOK sufficient?
- Are you expecting continuous evidence (daily deletion proof) or point-in-time attestations for a given retention window?

If you're available Wed 14:00 CET / Tue 09:00 ET we can do a 30-min sync. Otherwise we'll draft an inline checklist.

Best,

To answer your clarifications:

- KMS: Prefer customer-managed keys (BYOK) held in EU KMS (Azure Key Vault / GCP Cloud KMS in eu-west).
- Evidence cadence: we need both point-in-time attestations (quarterly) and ad-hoc proof-of-deletion on request (e.g., when we terminate the service or request data purges).

I've also added two specific asks in the attached doc: requested log retention windows, and a sample audit log extract for operator access.

See you on Wed.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 10:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: EU-only processing + SCCs — internal notes

Hannah — internal technical notes / proposed checklist for Marco (pulling from runtime + infra runbooks):

1) EU-only execution: We can pin inference workloads to EU-only GPU pools (eu-west-1, eu-west-3) and enforce VPC/subnet-level geofencing. Control plane calls (billing/metrics) are handled by a private control plane option — for Privamed we should offer the Private deployment (customer-managed control plane) so metadata never leaves the EU unless explicitly configured.

2) Caching/backups:
   - KV cache: in-memory by default; we do not persist KV cache snapshots to object storage unless explicit snapshotting is enabled. If they want zero-persistence, we can disable snapshotting and evict caches on node recycle.
   - Node PV snapshots/log backups: these are stored in region and can be configured to use EU-only storage classes. Snapshots are created on a configurable cadence (daily/weekly).

3) Sub-processors / logging: Logging and monitoring agents can be confined to EU operator services. Any third-party telemetry (e.g., managed APM) must be EU-only and contractually bound under SCCs.

4) KMS / key custody: We support customer-managed keys via standard BYOK flows (Azure/GCP). For extra assurance we can propose HSM-backed keys with key wrapping and restrict remote key export.

5) Proof-of-deletion artifacts we can provide:
   - S3/Blob lifecycle deletion logs (object deleted event) with timestamps
   - Snapshot deletion confirmation records (snapshot id + deletion timestamp)
   - Operator access audit trail (email + operator id + action)
   - KMS key rotation and wrap logs (where available)

6) Suggested evidence cadence: quarterly attestation bundle + on-demand deletion report within 10 business days.

I'll draft a one-page checklist we can send to Marco. Lauren/Naomi — anything to add from legal/regulatory?

—Aditya
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: EU-only processing + SCCs — in-region inference, backups and deletion evidence

Hi Marco / Ana — thanks again for the call today. Below is the promised checklist / commitments we can include in an SCCs annex and operational runbook for Privamed. If you want this in a PDF Annex we can produce a signed attestation.

Redwood commitments (EU-only configuration for Privamed):

- Workloads & Storage: inference nodes, persistent volumes, and snapshot/backup storage will be provisioned in EU regions only (we propose eu-west-1 with failover to eu-west-3).
- Control plane: offer Private deployment option so the control plane sits in your VPC / EU-only control plane region.
- Cache persistence: KV cache will not be snapshotted by default — we will disable snapshotting and evict caches on node recycle unless you request snapshot retention.
- Backups & snapshots: any automated snapshots or log backups will be stored in EU-only storage and can be retained for configurable windows (default 30 days).
- Sub-processors: all sub-processors with access to data in this configuration will be EU-based and contractually covered by SCCs; we will supply the sub-processor list and agreements.
- KMS / keys: support BYOK with customer-managed keys in EU KMS (Azure/GCP) and HSM-backed options on request.
- Evidence & attestation: quarterly attestation bundles (snapshots + deletion logs + operator audit extracts) and ad-hoc deletion reports within 10 business days. We will also provide sample audit log extracts to show operator access events.

Next steps:
1) We will prepare an SCCs annex draft and a one-page evidence checklist (PDF) for signature — target delivery: Fri 16 May.
2) Provide a sample audit log extract and a redacted snapshot deletion record (by Wed next week).
3) If Privamed wants customer-managed control plane, we will share deployment runbook and timeline (2–4 weeks for onboarding).

Links / artifacts: shared drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-privamed-eu-evidence (will be populated by EOD Fri). DocuSign for the annex: https://www.docusign.com/recipientview?envelopeId=ABC-PRIVAMED-2025

Let me know if you'd prefer a written Annex or a quick follow-up call to finalize the wording.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: SCCs_advice_v1.pdf, redwood-eu-arch.png
